facts.fact: Mobile money has operated in Botswana since 2018, offered by Orange, Mascom, BTC and BotswanaPost, with transactions worth P33.5 billion in the year to March 2024, per The Voice citing the BOCRA 2024 annual report.
The article states mobile money in Botswana is now interoperable with traditional bank accounts.
